title: 第9章 找当地气象局啊第10章 雷祖亲临
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
看着评论区里一排双手合十的表情包，林楠顿时有些哭笑不得起来。
虽说他现在，确实可以利用刚刚获得的阵法进行求雨。
但是他不能保证，由他画出来的阵法是否能够发挥应有的效果，万一阵法画了雨却没下，那岂不是很尴尬？
而且，这些拜他的网友们的IP都在不同的省份。
他总不能主动跟当地的气象部门抢活干吧？
所以林楠没有坚持站在原地，他一步一顿的，十分庄严的走到了镜头前，故意声音深沉符合神设的开口劝说道：
“虽说主播跟雷祖长得确实有点像，但是大家可别把我真当成雷祖了，我就是个角色扮演类的主播而已。”
“而且就算是求雨，按照地界划分，第一应该先找当地的气象局。
就算是气象局没啥办法，要拜也应该先拜当地的行雨神仙啊。”
“雷祖是管各大雷神的，并不是专门行雨的，还请大家不要再继续拜我了。”
林楠顶着一幅神明的装扮，却跟广大网友推荐找气象局解决问题。
这驴唇不搭马嘴的情况，让直播间放眼望去“哈”
声一片。
【哈哈哈哈，堂堂掌控风云雷电雨的雷祖，却让大家找气象部门，这画面也太搞笑了！
【关键主播还一脸庄严、认真的说出了这个建议，让画面显得更搞笑了。
【哈哈哈哈哈哈绝了！
我的礼物保不住了！
【收到“大嘴别吃了”
送出的饕餮盛宴*1】
见评论区的走向不太对，林楠无奈的同时，只得马上将话题引上了正轨。

“大家给的建议我已经收到了，关于法器的细节，大家可以跟我说一下嘛？”
“如果不是很麻烦的话，下了播我就自己做一做。”
“争取再下次直播的时候，把法器也一并给大家还原出来！”
【稍等，我去查查。
【嘿嘿，主播这可算是问到了我的舒适区了。
图片.jpg*2
这张图上的法器就是雌雄双鞭。
五雷令牌倒是挺好找的，搜搜就有。
我还是着重说一下雌雄双鞭吧。
content_en:
Looking at the row of emoticons with hands folded in the comment area, Lin Nan suddenly couldn't laugh or cry.
Although he can indeed use the formation he just obtained to pray for rain now.
But he couldn't guarantee whether the formation he drew would have the desired effect. Wouldn't it be embarrassing if it rained but it didn't fall?
Moreover, the IP addresses of these netizens who worship him are in different provinces.
He couldn't take the initiative to compete with the local meteorological department for work, could he?
So Lin Nan didn't insist on standing where he was. He stepped in front of the camera step by step and solemnly, and spoke in a deliberately deep and divine voice:
"Although the anchor does look a bit like Lei Zu, please don't think of me as Lei Zu. I'm just a role-playing anchor."
“And even if you want to ask for rain, according to the geographical boundaries, you should first contact the local meteorological bureau.
Even if the Meteorological Bureau has nothing to do, you should first worship the local rain god. "
"Lei Zu is in charge of all the major thunder gods, and is not specifically responsible for making rain. Please don't continue to worship me."
Lin Nan pretended to be a god, but he recommended to the majority of netizens to contact the Meteorological Bureau to solve the problem.
This non-committal situation made the live broadcast room look "ha"
There was a lot of sound.
[Hahahaha, Lei Zu, who is in control of the storm, thunder, lightning and rain, asked everyone to contact the meteorological department. This scene is too funny!
[The key anchor also said this suggestion solemnly and seriously, making the scene even more funny.
[Hahahahahahaha! Absolutely awesome!
I can’t keep my gift!
【Received "Don't eat big mouth"
A gluttonous feast*1]
Seeing that the direction of the comment section was not quite right, Lin Nan had no choice but to immediately put the topic on the right track.
"I have received your suggestions. Can you tell me the details about the magic weapon?"
"If it's not too much trouble, I'll do it myself after the broadcast."
"Try to restore the magic weapon to everyone during the next live broadcast!"
[Wait a minute, I'll check.
[Hey, the host is asking about my comfort zone.
Picture.jpg*2
The magic weapon in this picture is the male and female whip.
The Five Thunder Tokens are quite easy to find, you can find them on Sosou.
Let me focus on the male and female whips.
